name: Palette
description: Samples an image and returns four hex codes assigned to distinct roles, presented as a labelled bar chart split 55/20/20/5. Aimed at designers who want proportions attached to their colours rather than an unsorted swatch grid, so it is more use for layout decisions than for mood boards.

official.description: Turns a photo into a four-role colour palette: a labelled 55/20/20/5 bar chart and four hex codes sampled from the image. For designers who want colours...
